observed_sources.evidence: Democratic Republic of the Congo 9,704 confirmed cases 4,687 confirmed deaths

observed_sources.name: ECDC
observed_sources.evidence: As of 19 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported a total of 9 552 confirmed cases, including 4 602 related deaths (from data up until 18 October)

counts.outcome: Fresh direct extraction shows CDC 9,704/4,687 as of 2026-10-21 while ECDC remains 9,552/4,602 in its 2026-10-19 report with data through 2026-10-18. The required CDC/ECDC equality gate failed, so the complete prior canonical bundle was retained without advancing revision, publication time, outbreak dates, or verification.checked_at.

source_delivery_review.outcome: CDC direct parsing and current official-page content agree on 9,704/4,687 as of 2026-10-21. ECDC direct parsing and current official-page content agree on 9,552/4,602; its page says it was last updated 2026-10-20 at 15:00 but still uses DRC data through 2026-10-18. This is a widening cross-publisher synchronization conflict, not a connectivity-only check.

who_review.outcome: WHO External Situation Report 23 body content reports DRC 9,637 confirmed cases and 4,646 confirmed deaths as of 2026-10-19. It remains between the newer CDC value and stale ECDC value; no newer WHO report with 9,704/4,687 was content-verified. The mandatory CDC/ECDC equality gate therefore remains unsatisfied.

drc_review.outcome: No newer INSP SitRep content could be independently retrieved and content-verified in this audit. A reachable or indexed URL alone was not treated as verified evidence. The previous verified DRC snapshot remains retained.

research_history_review.outcome: WHO's current outbreak overview still states there is no licensed Bundibugyo vaccine or specific treatment. No verified research/history wording change requiring publication was identified. Population/displacement remains unimplemented pending a versioned official dataset and definition.

australia_review.outcome: Official destination page text was independently read after the direct adapter returned HTTP503; the alert wording and official update date are unchanged.

actions_review.counts: CDC/ECDC equality failed in the Action. Fresh audit then observed CDC 9,704/4,687 versus ECDC 9,552/4,602.
actions_review.advisories: US returned HTTP403 in the Action; all other configured adapters passed. Fresh cloud audit verified US directly and independently found only AU transport HTTP503; current official AU content was verified unchanged.
